svg.text: SONIC-Academy · illustrated action guide
Check the web runtime and reopen carefully
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Private client → helpdesk.lab.example.test; APP01 logs
On APP01 create the temporary version-check file below in this site’s physical root. From your
private client open https://helpdesk.lab.example.test/php-version-check.php. Compare its version,
cgi-fcgi SAPI and loaded php.ini path with your candidate. CLI output alone is not enough.
Require at least 8.4.27 on the supported 8.4 branch and review current PHP advisories for any
newer security floor. If the page still reports the old runtime or wrong configuration, keep
the site unavailable and inspect the site mapping, candidate FastCGI entry and environment
variables.
Remove the temporary file, set the help desk Online for your practice client and repeat login,
known ticket lookup, new ticket, reply, attachment and configured mail checks. Review new
IIS/PHP errors. If an acceptance check fails, stop the pool and follow the rollback decision;
do not leave a broken or vulnerable site serving.
Record the new runtime, test results and time. If the checks pass, reopen normal practice
access, monitor errors and retain the protected previous configuration until the agreed
retention period ends.
Check: The actual website uses the patched candidate, acceptance checks pass and the temporary
page is gone.
